title: RPSC Sub Jailor Competitive Exam  2026
vacancyDetails: Provisional list of 183 candidates declared successful for interview
qualification: As per the RPSC Sub Jailor Competitive Examination 2024 notification
ageLimit: As per the official RPSC notification
applicationFee: As per the official RPSC notification
selectionProcess: Competitive Examination → Provisional interview shortlist → Interview → Final result
documentsRequired: Detailed application form in duplicate, educational/technical certificates, caste and other required certificates as specified by RPSC, and a valid photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in
2. Open the RPSC Results section
3. Download the Sub Jailor Competitive Examination 2024 interview result PDF
4. Search the PDF for your roll number
5. If shortlisted, submit the detailed application form and required certificates by 12 September 2026 as instructed
shortDescription: RPSC Sub Jailor Competitive Examination 2024 interview result notice released. Check the provisional list of 183 successful candidates and document submission instructions.
content:
Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the result notice for the Sub Jailor (Prison Department) Competitive Examination 2024.

The PDF contains the provisional list of 183 candidates declared successful for the interview stage. Shortlisted candidates must download and submit the detailed application form in duplicate along with the required educational, caste and other certificates.

As stated in the notice, the required documents should reach the Commission office by 12 September 2026. Candidates should read the official PDF carefully for eligibility verification and interview instructions.
